enhancement: localize resource descriptions by convention (#4778)

* enhancement: localize resource descriptions by convention

* fix: let the locale file win over self.description on resources

The original patch had it the other way round — an explicit self.description
beat the translation key — so an app keeping an English default in code could
never translate over it.

That's backwards from the rest of Avo. Actions have resolved the locale file
first since 4.0.17, cards, dashboards and scopes since 4.1.2, and both the
docs and the shipped avo-i18n skill say it outright: the locale file beats a
class attribute, which is what lets an app keep English defaults in code and
translate over them without touching the class. Resources were the odd one out.

Reads like BaseAction#resolve_option now. Also adds the spec for the
precedence itself, which was the one thing not covered, and the avo-i18n and
avo-update skill notes — the latter because a resource with a description
lambda and a matching locale key silently stops calling the lambda, which is
what that upgrade section exists to warn about.
